title: Golden Morning
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Old guitar leaning by the door
Streetlights painting shadows on the wall

[Chorus]
We are golden in the afterglow
The rhythm of the wheels keeps time

[Verse 2]
Streetlights painting shadows on the wall
Old guitar leaning by the door

[Chorus]
We are golden in the afterglow
The rhythm of the wheels keeps time

[Outro]
We are the song we sing
structure: Intro (4 bars) / Verse (16) / Chorus (16) / Verse (16) / Chorus (16) / Bridge (8) / Chorus (16) / Outro (4)
desc: A epic trap song at 93 BPM in A minor, written by the Signature song engine.
